children.game_version: Twist 'Freeze' game where children dance until the music stops.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the hip and torso rotation while seated in a sturdy chair.
seniors.standing_version: Perform with support from a chair or wall for balance.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and smaller range of motion.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Bent at elbows, moving independently of the torso.
movement_profile.footwork: Grinding the balls of the feet against the floor.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Solo or crowd, requires minimal space.
movement_profile.posture: Low, knees slightly bent, torso upright.

signature_moves.description: Grinding the ball of the foot into the floor.
signature_moves.name: The Cigarette Grind

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Consistent with the driving beat of the music.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid excessive vertical bouncing or high-impact jumps.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Driving backbeat typical of rock and roll.
music_profile.sound_description: A high-energy, guitar-driven sound with a prominent, steady drum beat that encourages rhythmic hip movement.

basic_steps: Rotate hips and torso as a single unit.
Grind the balls of the feet against the floor as if putting out a cigarette.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner-friendly due to the lack of complex footwork or partner coordination.
teaching.rhythm: 4/4 time, steady rock and roll beat.
